orgorg.reason: Verified during wave 1 and rejected: no agent-controllable surface (auth catch-all answers 200 for every path, /docs redirects to /signout, robots.txt disallows /api/, no public API/docs/MCP) and no project-management head-to-head fit — it is a Google-Workspace-adjacent productivity suite (go-links, org chart, all-hands Q&A), not an issue/sprint/project tracker.

vly-ai-2.reason: Verified during wave 1 and rejected: acquired by Freebuff — vly.ai is now a redirect billboard (subscriptions cancelled, no signup path, the only product link points at freebuff.com/web), and docs.vly.ai documents only the sunset builder UI. The successor Freebuff Web is a different brand and should be nominated on its own merits.
